falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 total return is at least +6% over the next 14 calendar days and VIX closes below 15 on the final session of that window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug analog resolved into a confirmed risk-on thrust, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was wrong — the correct call was a long, not inaction

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 total return is -6% or worse over the next 14 calendar days and the index closes below its lowest close of the prior 20 sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% bottom-pattern match failed; price broke support instead of basing, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was wrong — the correct call was risk-off

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70, or US high-yield OAS widens by 50 basis points or more versus the current reading, within 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Regime left the ambiguous non-blowoff band (score 38); either a blowoff or a credit stress shock made HOLD/UNKNOWN the wrong classification

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
